parsed.summary: I checked the netlist against the SPICE deck and found them consistent for every passive value and connection I traced. Power, gate-drive, isolated I2C, TMC2209 driver and feedback networks all match their stated roles. The only open item is U7 (TPS62933) EN left unconnected, which is flagged as a no-connect in the netlist and is not clearly wrong without the part's internal pull behaviour, so I am not reporting it.
